## Data Source & Pre-processing

This analysis investigates the cognitive domains where AI exceeds human capabilities using the [AI Benchmarks vs Human Baselines](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/kylefengkfeng209/ai-benchmarks-vs-human-baselines) Kaggle dataset.

To ensure offline reproducibility and adhere to file size constraints, a static snapshot of the dataset was committed to `data/benchmarks.csv`. 

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load the curated dataset
benchmark_data <- read_csv("../../data/benchmarks.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Create the binary target variable for the model
benchmark_data <- benchmark_data |> 
  mutate(Is_Superhuman = ifelse(ai_top_score > human_baseline, 1, 0))

# Inspect the modeling features
benchmark_data |> 
  select(benchmark_name, category, Is_Superhuman) |> 
  glimpse()
```
